justification: Deterministic address-uniform queue independent of detailed REST slots. Four portfolio calls per 15-minute tick reserve at most 80 weights, averaging 5.333 weights/minute. Recent shared telemetry measured 844.83 reserved weights/minute over 60 minutes and 853.70 over 24 hours with zero 429s. The existing local limiter remains authoritative; no request bypasses it. Retries remain bounded and charged to that same limiter. No AI budget or RE call is included.
